{"path": "/tmp/test_search.py", "file_text": "from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users
from app.db import store

# Setup dummy users
store._USERS = {
    1: {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
    2: {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"},
    3: {"id": 3, "name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"},
}

def test_search():
    # Test valid query
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "ad"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
    
    # Test case insensitive
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "ADA"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}

    # Test no results
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "xyz"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": []}

    # Test invalid queries
    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "   "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_search()
    print("All tests passed!")
"}

    1: {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
    2: {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"},
    3: {"id": 3, "name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"},
}

    # Test valid query
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "ad"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
    
    # Test case insensitive
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "ADA"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}

    # Test no results
    status, res = handle_search_users({"q": "xyz"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"users": []}

    # Test invalid queries

    assert handle_search_users({"q": "   "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})

    test_search()
    print("All tests passed!")
